text: You recently faced a financial issue and want to cancel or return all possible orders.  Well, except the boots that you really really love, but you are happy to exchange it for boots of the exact same size and material to get maximum money back, but only if they are cheaper than what you have paid. If there are NO cheaper boots available you want the agent to keep the order and cancel the other items. At the end of the day, you ask the agent how much money you will get back.
zh: 您最近遇到了财务问题，想取消或退货所有可能的订单。不过，除了您非常非常喜欢的靴子（#W1234567，鞋子，尺码和材质必须完全相同，以便获得最大退款，但前提是它们比您支付的更便宜。如果没有任何更便宜的靴子可用，您希望代理人保留该订单并取消其他商品。最终，您要求代理人告知您将获得多少退款。
